briefs.lead: On 28 February 2026, war involving Iran led to the near-closure of the Strait of Hormuz, the narrow sea lane between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula. Still showing in the data: about 3 ships a day in the four weeks to 15 November 2026, against a typical 86 for this time of year.

Commercial elevators and port terminals held 7.25 million tonnes of grain in the week ending 4 October 2026. Higher than in any of the previous 5 years for this time of year (2% above the median). Worth a closer look; not by itself a sign of crisis.
